entries.70b1c9bb0d302ef4: The company's purpose is to pass on a safe and secure everyday life to the next generation by continuing to protect the value of social infrastructure. The medium-term management plan for fiscal 2026 to fiscal 2028 aims to shift to a knowledge-intensive business model that uses the vast anticorrosion data accumulated over 75 years, and to become an 'infrastructure family doctor' that grasps and evaluates the condition of social infrastructure and proposes optimal countermeasures. It also intends to establish new business fields such as offshore wind power generation and RC bridge structures.

entries.b3bcab3fe585a5c7: The company has pursued anticorrosion technology as its specialty since its founding in 1951. It has a system that allows it to handle everything in-house, from corrosion investigation and analysis through anticorrosion design, countermeasure works, maintenance and renewal, and has developed proprietary methods and technologies such as the PTC method, targeting the tidal zone of port structures, and the NICE system, a corrosion diagnosis method for reinforced concrete structures. The ALAP aluminum alloy anticorrosion anode is manufactured in-house at the Ageo Factory.
